name: First useful spec section
description: Defines the README section that suggests good first Grounded specs.
heading: Your first useful spec
intro: Good first candidates are facts that already cause confusion or repeated explanations:
items: "Generated docs must not be edited by hand."
"A completed todo cannot be reopened without an explicit reopen action."
outro: Start with one fact. Give it a stable ID. Link other docs, tests, plans, and prompts back to that ID.
